settingsAboutDataBody.en: Sign-in and your data use Supabase: your certifications and their PDFs are stored in your account and available on any device where you sign in. A read-only copy of the last data loaded is kept on this device for when you're offline.

Se guarda en este dispositivo una copia de solo lectura de los últimos datos cargados para cuando no tengas conexión.

settingsPrivacyDataBody.en: Authentication is provided by Supabase. Your email and credentials are processed by Supabase; this app does not store your password.
settingsPrivacyDataBody.es: La autenticación la provee Supabase. Tu correo y credenciales los procesa Supabase; esta app no guarda tu contraseña.

settingsPrivacyInfraBody.en: Your certifications, tags and certificate PDFs are stored in Supabase, tied to your account and protected so only you can read them. A copy of the last data loaded is kept on this device to show it offline, and is deleted when you sign out. Verification links open in an in-app browser and are handled by the site they point to. Security and backups depend on that service. Use a strong password.
settingsPrivacyInfraBody.es: Tus certificaciones, etiquetas y PDF de certificados se guardan en Supabase, asociados a tu cuenta y protegidos para que solo tú puedas leerlos. En este dispositivo se guarda una copia de los últimos datos cargados para verlos sin conexión, y se borra al cerrar sesión. Los enlaces de verificación se abren en un navegador dentro de la app y los gestiona el sitio al que apuntan. La seguridad y los respaldos dependen de ese servicio. Usa una contraseña segura.

settingsPrivacyInfraTitle.en: What we store today — and later

settingsPrivacySharingBody.en: We do not sell your personal information or use your data to target ads. Apart from the sign-in and storage service, this app does not send your data to anyone.
